**Roll back `dep-4471`.** Handoff is at [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).

Its config set connection-per-request on the gateway. Pool size stayed 20, so request 21 queues. Deploy finished `02:14:00Z`, first 503 at `02:14:18.972Z`.

Impact: 530 of 636 requests failed after the deploy, 83%. Still failing when the log ends at `03:59:27`. Never recovered.

Two open items. This log is `node-3 of 3`, so check nodes 1 and 2. Raising pool size is a stopgap only, the queue was still growing at 74.
